## sidha-fixture-shape-check

Apache-2.0. Free to import. No Warp file and no hosted service.

Inflammatory-disease fixture shape checks for the columns and FHIR fields sidha.ehr already reads. Hidradenitis suppurativa is the flagship example in some sample codes, not a filter that rejects other diseases.

Not an OHDSI DataQualityDashboard run. Not full OMOP CDM or FHIR profile conformance.

Fixtures are pinned to commit 7d73ee824910969f27ea9c545de9200e7794bebd. A missing date is a skip and does not by itself fail the run.

nodes.notes: Disabled. URL parameter is empty unless you paste your own endpoint and enable this node. Do not hard-code Slack, email, or GitHub. The summary does not include fixture bodies.
